verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents RESTful CRUD and record insertion (up to 100 per call) and an official MCP server that works with Claude Desktop, Cursor and similar tools, so an agent can create and update lead records programmatically. Owner assignment is only implied, through generic CRUD and workflow-based lead routing to reps. No native company-data enrichment source is evidenced, so the agent would have to supply firmographic data itself. Missing for 10: documented native company/firmographic enrichment, explicit API/MCP owner-assignment examples, an end-to-end MCP lead-creation walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
